name: Jade Dragon Statuette
description: This detailedly carved statuette, made from deep green jade, depicts a serpentine dragon with eyes of polished obsidian. It fits comfortably in the palm of a hand and feels cool to the touch. The Jade Dragon Statuette is a magic item imbued with the power to detect magic. When held and activated with a prayer of Fumetsu Eido, the eyes of the dragon glow softly, pulsating in the presence of magical items or spells. It can detect magic within a 30-foot radius for 10 minutes. Then, it needs to recharge its energy at dawn to be used again. If used near an angelic artifact (including those of Tenshikin), it can reveal the artifact’s exact location when the protection is activated, and a hundred copies appear.
